feedback.problem:
Let $P=QR.$ What is the value of ${p}_{31}$, if

$$
Q=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 4 & -1 \\ 2 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}],\,R=[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 \\ -3 & 2 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}]?
$$

${p}_{31}=$
{{field-1}}
feedback.worked_solution:
Multiplying the $3$rd row in $Q$ by the $1$st column in $R$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{p}_{31} & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 4 & -1 \\ 2 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 & 0 \\ -3 & 2 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 \\ -3 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =2(5)+1(-3)+(-2)(1) \\  & =10-3-2 \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$
